THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
186
STUDY 114
Raglan Cross Graphic Tee & Cargo
Rights check
Source: 24998.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a messy
updo wears a black and white raglan long-sleeve tee
with a large gothic cross graphic and chain-link detail. A
black leather belt with a silver buckle cinches black
cargo trousers. Her expression is calm and direct. A
pale backdrop with white cars at the sides. Palette of
black, white, and gunmetal. Edgy and bold, in the style
of a streetwear graphic lookbook.
Edgy, bold, streetwear
WORKING NOTES
- The gothic cross and raglan sleeves are the defining
graphics.
- Keep the white cars for a clean, sleek background.
